name: Text
author: OpenPen
description: Places text anywhere on screen: click to type; Enter or click away commits as-is, Esc cancels, Shift+Enter adds a line; commits cannot be re-edited.

descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 點一下就能在畫面上打字標註，支援輸入法與多行，完成後可復原或重做。
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hans: 点一下就能在画面上打字标注，支持输入法与多行，完成后可撤销或重做。

screenshots.alt: Red text notes sit beside a blog post.
A click places a caret, a note is typed, and the font size is changed before it is committed.

changelog: Add a marketplace icon, cover image and Traditional and Simplified Chinese descriptions.
Add a style panel beside the Text button to set font size, font, bold and italic.
Press Ctrl+Alt+T (Command+Option+T on macOS) to switch to the text tool.
Hold Ctrl and scroll the mouse wheel while typing to change the font size.
